Heyyy. I was literally mid-bite of this sad little quesadilla I threw together because I got lazy and didn’t want to cook the recipe I planned. I was supposed to make this roasted tomato soup situation but my grocery store was out of decent tomatoes and I got annoyed and gave up. Now I’m on the couch with my candle going, half-watching this messy reality show where two people are fighting over a guy named… Chad. Of course it’s a Chad.

What’s up on your side? I was just thinking about you earlier when I passed that spot where we got those ridiculous milkshakes that one time. I swear that sugar crash almost took me out.
